fields.label: Handover Requirement
fields.options:
Off
Warn
Require on Approval
Require on Submission
Require Acceptance before Submission
fields.description: Off: handover optional. Warn: notify if no cover. Require on Approval: must have agreed stand-in before approval. Require on Submission: staff must prepare handover with stand-in before submitting/applying. Require Acceptance before Submission: stand-in must accept before staff can submit/apply.

fields.label: Only for Leave of at Least (Days)
fields.description: Short absences often need no handover. Leave at 0 to apply to every length of leave.

fields.label: Remind Staff to Hand Over (Days Before)
fields.description: How many days before their leave starts staff are reminded, on My Desk, to prepare a handover.

fields.label: Also Email the Reminder
fields.description: Email each member of staff once, that many days before their leave, if nobody has been asked to cover their work yet. The reminder on My Desk shows either way.

fields.label: Only for These Kinds of Leave
fields.description: Leave empty to apply to every kind. Sick leave, for instance, is often taken without warning.

name: Task Assignment Policy
description: Per company: whether leave needs a stand-in who has agreed to cover before it can be approved.
